problems.title: Sum of two numbers
problems.description:
Read two integers and print their sum.

Input:
3 4

Output:
7

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Even or odd
problems.description:
Read an integer n (n >= 0). Print Even if it is even, otherwise Odd.

Input:
7

Output:
Odd

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Factorial
problems.description:
Read n (0 <= n <= 15) and print n! (use long).

Input:
5

Output:
120

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Reverse a string
problems.description:
Read one line of text and print it reversed.

Input:
hello

Output:
olleh

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Palindrome check
problems.description:
Read one word. Print true if it reads the same forwards and backwards, otherwise false (case-sensitive).

Input:
madam

Output:
true

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Count vowels
problems.description:
Read one line and print how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u - any case) it contains.

Input:
hello world

Output:
3

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Largest number in an array
problems.description:
Read n, then n integers. Print the largest one.

Input:
5
3 9 2 7 4

Output:
9

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Sum of array elements
problems.description:
Read n, then n integers. Print their sum.

Input:
5
1 2 3 4 5

Output:
15

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Second largest number
problems.description:
Read n, then n integers (at least two distinct values). Print the second largest distinct value.

Input:
5
3 9 2 7 4

Output:
7

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Remove duplicates
problems.description:
Read n, then n integers. Print the distinct values in their original order, separated by single spaces. Hint: LinkedHashSet.

Input:
6
1 2 2 3 1 4

Output:
1 2 3 4

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Count distinct words
problems.description:
Read one line of words separated by spaces. Print how many different words it contains.

Input:
the cat the dog

Output:
3

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: First non-repeating character
problems.description:
Read one word. Print the first character that appears exactly once, or none if there is no such character. Hint: LinkedHashMap.

Input:
swiss

Output:
w

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Animal sounds (inheritance)
problems.description:
Create a class Animal with a method speak() returning "..." and subclasses Dog, Cat and Cow that override speak() to return "Woof", "Meow" and "Moo". Read a word (dog, cat or cow), create the matching object through an Animal reference and print its speak().

Input:
dog

Output:
Woof

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Shape area (polymorphism)
problems.description:
Input is either "circle r" or "rect w h" (decimals allowed). Use an abstract class or interface Shape with area(), and one subclass per shape. Print the area with 2 decimals using String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", value).

Input:
rect 3 4

Output:
12.00

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Student class (encapsulation)
problems.description:
Create a class Student with private fields name and marks, a constructor and getters. Read a name and marks, build a Student and print: <name> scored <marks>.

Input:
Asha 90

Output:
Asha scored 90

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Fibonacci
problems.description:
Read n (0 <= n <= 30). Print the n-th Fibonacci number where F(0)=0 and F(1)=1. Try a recursive solution first.

Input:
10

Output:
55

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Prime check
problems.description:
Read n. Print true if n is prime, otherwise false.

Input:
7

Output:
true

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.

problems.title: Greatest common divisor
problems.description:
Read two positive integers and print their GCD (Euclid's algorithm).

Input:
12 18

Output:
6

Your class must be named Main and read from standard input.
